msg: Hi there! My husband and I are on a cruise and we dock in Cartagena next Thursday at 7am. The ship leaves at 5pm sharp. We're both certified divers (PADI Advanced). Is there any dive trip that gets us back in time?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

A day of diving in the Rosario Islands is a fantastic experience. The certified-diving trip from Cartagena meets at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. That leaves less than an hour before your ship departs at 5:00 p.m., so I can’t confirm it would give you enough time to get back aboard safely.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes from Cartagena, we have no hotel, just the ship. 4:15 is cutting it close but the port is near the old town. Is there any shorter option, like one dive, that gets back earlier? Otherwise how much is the 2 dive trip?
reply:
There isn’t a shorter one-dive option available from Cartagena. The two-dive trip returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m., so it would be very tight for your ship’s 5:00 p.m. departure. The price is the same in either currency; only the currency changes.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: No, we dove in Cozumel in June. OK we'll take the risk with the 2 dives. If the boat is late coming back, does anyone help us get to the cruise terminal? And how do we book and pay, we're American.
reply:
The boat is scheduled to return to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m., with an estimated arrival around 4:15 p.m. Ground transportation to the cruise terminal isn’t included, and I can’t confirm whether anyone could help if the boat is delayed. Given your ship’s 5:00 p.m. departure, the timing is very tight.

To book and pay, use the online link below. International guests pay 100% by card on the website; the 10% online discount is applied automatically. With a foreign card, use your passport as the ID document. The booking is recorded right away, and the team reconciles the payment shortly after to confirm it.

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
